notes.title: The Candyland
notes.content:
Take me down to the candy land, where trees are sweet and the fun is grand!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295122/b01d4d3c9cb86846c6e2bfcb33f5a8bb3a4c4959.jpg[/img]

Embark on a journey through giant lollipops, sugar sands, and dog-sized brownies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295122/a8593583ab4b412751e43780b92e5c52c5425742.jpg[/img]

Take a ride on the carousel and make sure that everything is in order.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295122/4b0302ad8268254b9001ed2e36c53866eff2817b.jpg[/img]

Make Candyland an every child’s dream!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295122/88793054d0a04078526e4b4c08b348f7c0be7d39.jpg[/img]

Changelog: 
[list]
[*] A brand new region, The Candyland. 
[*] A dynamic weather system (in progress)
[*] Written and recorded Noah and Leo monologues
[*] Created a simple pest AI. So that the rats would run from the brothers.
[*] Destroying objects with a hammer mechanic (physically collapsing objects).
[*] Created some new UI art for the park map. 
[*] Updated the tablet UI. 
[*] 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295122/17f6de3932bbaff28439b93b402ee05aac35ef82.jpg[/img]

Remember to brush your teeth regularly and stay tuned for more updates on Rollercoaster Mechanic!

We hope you also enjoy the announcement of our new Farm Renovator game. Check out the trailer and be sure to add the game to your Wishlist.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_yy8CSf_TS0&t=3s

notes.title: Devlog #5 - May developement summary
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/YTprxjY/rust-remover-discord.gif[/img]

[h2]Hello, Rollercoaster Mechanic community![/h2]

It's time, to sum up, the developement process in May. We made a lot of work in terms of design and modeling. Most of the tools that you will use in Rollercoaster Mechanic are already prepared, but some of them still need improvements before we share them with you. 

Also, other models and functionalities are looking better and better. We will share more details really soon.

Short brief of what we achieved in may:

[list]
[*] Reference architecture model with textures, divided into modular parts.
[*]   Thus, the start of the work of external graphic designers on the basis of the above-mentioned Model over the main level architecture and coordination of work progress and ongoing quality control.
[*]   Tool model - Pew Pew Cleaner
[*]   Fixed bugs related to the UI quest system.
[*]   Fixed character placement after initiating camera zoom in.
[*] Recognition and an outline introduction to the gameplay mechanic.
[*] Numerous in-design improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]

[h2]Stay tuned for upcoming updates![/h2]
